_note: This skill's checked-in routing corpus. NOTE: ref-polyfills is a REFERENCE skill — it ANSWERS browser-support / polyfill / transpilation / Baseline / feature-detection / browser-bug questions and points at peers (ui-build-components, analyze-css) for output; it does NOT generate components, debug a stylesheet, build ramps, or grade on two axes. Its frontmatter uses ## Invocation + domain sections, not the decomposer template, but the corpus still applies: does the description route on real browser-support questions and hold against its design-skills siblings? Positives span the question families (will-browsers-support-X / do-I-need-a-polyfill-for-Y / is-Z-Baseline / how-do-I-feature-detect-W / transpile-target / known-browser-bug) plus 2-3 indirect/symptom paraphrases. Negatives are drawn ADVERSARIALLY from real in-repo design-skills siblings — color-science (color math/contrast/conversions, NOT browser support), component-decomposer (decompose/grade a web component, not its browser support), color-verifier (BUILD an OKLCH ramp), focus-verifier (focus-ring/hit-target tokens), i18n-verifier (locale primitives), perf-verifier (perceived latency/CLS), safety-verifier (blast-radius/undo) — plus GLOBAL peers analyze-css (debug/review a stylesheet) and ui-build-components (GENERATE component code), and the cross-family near-misses (routing-decomposer / mermaid-decomposer / regex-decomposer / skills-studio). IMPORTANT: routing-eval measures LEXICAL TOKEN OVERLAP only — it is a legibility aid, not a verdict. The indirect/symptom positives deliberately share few surface words and may score recall 0.000; that is a proxy limit (paraphrase-blindness), not a description defect. Re-derive when the neighbourhood changes.
